receiptSetlist.name: Receipt Setlist

availability.summary: Shows sung details from the arrangement, or records during general playback.

receiptSetlist.summary: Thermal-receipt style tracks and sung records.
receiptSetlist.detail: Prints a slip after each song; switch direction and review sung details on a timer.

2.label: Title
2.value: Up to two lines, long titles truncated

3.label: Review
3.value: Timed review, can be turned off

queueBoard.name: Night Setlist

availability.summary: Uses the current track and sung records.

queueBoard.detail: The current track stays on top; sung records stack below and scroll smoothly.

karaokeStack.name: Classic Karaoke

availability.summary: Supports per-character wipe; estimates by line length without per-character timing.

karaokeStack.summary: Alternating two lines, countdown and per-character wipe.
karaokeStack.detail: Two lines alternate, cues count down ahead and text wipes with progress.

0.label: Shows
0.value: Top line left, bottom line right

3.label: Look
3.value: White text, blue outline, role-colored wipe

4.label: Progress
4.value: Estimated per line / exact per character

mangaFrame.name: Manga Panels

availability.summary: Uses the current line and can show available Japanese readings.

mangaFrame.summary: Vertical manga dialogue alternating left and right.
mangaFrame.detail: Lyrics split into one to three vertical speech panels that alternate sides each line.

2.label: Phrasing
2.value: Split into panels at spaces and brackets

kineticPop.name: Kinetic Pop
kineticPop.summary: Bold gradient text that pops in character by character.
kineticPop.detail: Characters pop in at fixed points; keep one of three textures or rotate them.

1.label: Texture
1.value: Gradient with white outline by default; fixed or rotating

3.label: Transition
3.value: Characters pop in at fixed points

ornateVertical.name: Japanese Vertical

availability.summary: Uses line-timed lyrics and groups Japanese kanji automatically.

ornateVertical.summary: Vertical Mincho; kanji appear in groups, kana one by one.
ornateVertical.detail: Vertical Mincho text; long lines split into columns automatically. Color, size and position are adjustable.

2.label: Long lines
2.value: Split into up to two columns

3.label: Transition
3.value: Kanji in groups, kana one by one

centeredVertical.name: Centered Vertical
centeredVertical.summary: One centered vertical column with a fixed starting point.
centeredVertical.detail: Read from top to bottom. Lyrics cut directly to the next line, and long lines flow across pages on the same axis.

chalkboardVertical.name: Chalkboard Vertical
chalkboardVertical.summary: White chalk and rules reveal one character at a time.
chalkboardVertical.detail: Choose the left or right third. Columns read from right to left, while text and rules erase in opposite directions.

liveStage.name: Stage Captions

availability.summary: Needs line timing; the opening card uses track info.

liveStage.summary: Broadcast-style lyrics and an opening card.
liveStage.detail: Lyrics at the lower left and the opening card at the lower right, leaving the center for the performer.

0.label: Lyrics
0.value: Wide at lower left, up to two lines

1.label: Presentation
1.value: Concise, balanced or faithful to the original

2.label: Card
2.value: Compact at lower right, 4–8 seconds after playback starts

4.label: Branding
4.value: Low-key stage branding at the top

artCard.name: Starlit Vinyl

availability.summary: Uses local artwork; shows the first character of the title when missing.

artCard.summary: Album artwork with a star-dyed vinyl record.
artCard.detail: Artwork on the left and a star-dyed record on the right that turns slowly while playing.

1.label: Motion
1.value: Spins while playing, still when paused

coverPlayer.name: Cover Radio

availability.summary: Uses local artwork; shows the first character of the title when missing.

coverPlayer.summary: Large artwork with a color-matched background and playback progress.
coverPlayer.detail: Vertical player showing artwork, track, progress and volume.
